# process

In [EhOsContract.Contract](contract-dsl.md), section `contract`.

```elixir
process name, label
```

The process the contract describes, if any, at most one: its runs, stages and promises.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-process-name"></a>`name` | `atom` | yes |  | The process's name, which keys its runs. |
| <a id="contract-process-label"></a>`label` | `String.t` | yes |  | What the business calls it. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-process-correlate"></a>`correlate` | `atom \| list(atom)` | yes |  | The fields that tell which run an event belongs to. |
| <a id="contract-process-accountable"></a>`accountable` | `atom` |  |  | The actor a finding about the process is addressed to. |
| <a id="contract-process-source"></a>`source` | `String.t` |  |  | Where the process comes from in the material. |

Inside it: [`stage`](#contract-process-stage), [`include`](#contract-process-include), [`deadline`](#contract-process-deadline), [`promise`](#contract-process-promise).

## process.stage

```elixir
stage name, label \\ nil
```

One stage of the process, in order; consumed events are placed with `include`.

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |

Inside it: [`include`](#contract-process-stage-include).

<a id="contract-process-deadline"></a>

## process.deadline

```elixir
deadline within
```

How long a run may take, from its first event to a terminal one.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-process-deadline-within"></a>`within` | `any` | yes |  | `{n, unit}`, in a fixed unit. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-process-deadline-unverified"></a>`unverified` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Not confirmed by the process owner. |


<a id="contract-process-promise"></a>

## process.promise

```elixir
promise name
```

After one event of a run, another eventually follows.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-process-promise-name"></a>`name` | `atom` | yes |  | The promise's name. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| <a id="contract-process-promise-from"></a>`from` | `atom` | yes |  | The event that opens the promise. |
| <a id="contract-process-promise-eventually"></a>`eventually` | `atom` | yes |  | The event that keeps it. |
| <a id="contract-process-promise-within"></a>`within` | `any` |  |  | `{n, unit}`, in a fixed unit. |
| <a id="contract-process-promise-or_else"></a>`or_else` | `atom` |  |  | An event that keeps it the other way. |
| <a id="contract-process-promise-unverified"></a>`unverified` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Not confirmed by the process owner. |
| <a id="contract-process-promise-source"></a>`source` | `String.t` |  |  | Where the promise comes from. |
